title: Selection Sort
definition: An in-place comparison sorting algorithm that divides the input into a sorted and an unsorted region. It repeatedly selects the smallest element from the unsorted region and moves it to the sorted region. O(N^2).
simpleExplanation: Scanning the entire crowd for the absolute shortest person, bringing them to the front, then scanning everyone else for the next shortest person.

answers.question: **Basic:** Identify the core logic required to implement Selection Sort.
**Intermediate 1:** Solve a standard problem using Selection Sort in O(N log N) or O(N) time.
**Intermediate 2:** Adapt Selection Sort to handle strings or distinct objects instead of numbers.
**Advanced:** Use Selection Sort to solve a complex sub-array or sub-string problem (e.g. Longest non-repeating).
**Expert/FAANG:** Optimize Selection Sort to achieve strictly O(1) space constraints while maintaining linear time.
